verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the address can be used for online shopping, that operators scan packages and labels, and that users can forward letters and packages domestically or internationally or schedule a pickup. That covers receiving, holding and forwarding parcels. However, nothing documents acceptance from all major carriers or package consolidation, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit acceptance of all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hands-on or independent confirmation.
